hero.subtitle: Multidisciplinary Artist
hero.description: Intersection of art, technology, and science. From material analysis to technical execution: programming systems and sculpting ideas in wood, ink, and paper.

about.description: I'm Xavier Arbat, a polymath in progress with a homo faber vocation. I understand creativity as a process of inquiry into how things work, where technology, materials and analysis go hand in hand. My work doesn't just seek narrative — it seeks excellence in execution: from code architecture to the resilience of wood or the delicacy of pencil. I turn technical curiosity into works where every material and every decision has a reason to be.

portfolio.description: Cross-disciplinary explorations at the intersection of art, technology and artisan praxis.
